root_cause: Intermediate pass rate (1/3) on a golden TEXT_MISMATCH whose failing turn is an open-ended reassurance follow-up ('Oh good, so nobody's coming out?'). The agent's behavior is correct and grounded -- cancel_alarm returns dispatch_status='not dispatched' and the instruction (lines 132-135) explicitly tells the agent to reassure about dispatch status from the tool response. The two failing runs scored sem_score=2 (just under the semantic-match threshold) because the free-form phrasing of the closing reassurance varies run-to-run, not because the agent said anything wrong. This is non-deterministic LLM phrasing variance, not a deterministic agent bug.
